service: Assistance for Isolated Children: parental income assessment
title: AIC parental income test — process tables
document_date: version date not displayed in inspected excerpt
finding: Staff action tables name processing teams, case-system screens, eligibility branches, evidence requests and termination points.
limitations: Linked intranet tools are not public; this is a component of AIC administration, not a validated complete map.

title: ABSTUDY processing arrangements — process
document_date: version date not displayed in inspected excerpt
finding: Specifies enquiry channels, staff queues, escalation, record creation and callback actions for education assistance.
limitations: Education-related financial assistance is counted under social benefits, not as a second education-service area. Linked operational tools remain inaccessible.

title: Reconsideration after refusal
locator: Main procedure and GCMS Notes requirements
finding: Explains officer discretion, routing to the original or delegated decision maker and mandatory case-system recording.
limitations: A bounded reconsideration workflow; other visa processing stages need additional manuals.

service: Public loan negotiation and debt registration
title: Manuel de procédures de gestion de la dette publique
finding: Tables specify responsible units, ordered tasks, indicative deadlines, inputs, outputs and SYGADE/Excel registration.
limitations: Some document date fields are blank; indicative timelines are not observed performance.

service: Treasury crisis communication and operational management
title: Manuel de procédures de la DGTCP, 7e édition
finding: Named staff and crisis committee handle detection, recording, escalation, response or closure; includes evidence-retention requirements.
limitations: 445-page manual; only selected procedures inspected. Other listed functions are leads, not verified breadth.

service: International humanitarian assistance receipt, transit and dispatch
title: Manual de procedimientos para asistencia humanitaria y técnica internacional
document_date: 2017 approval record; edition date not independently resolved
locator: PDF p. 13, printed pp. 24–25; diagram visually inspected
finding: A swimlane blueprint assigns ordered actions and handoffs to customs, emergency and coordination bodies.
limitations: Historical approval record; current implementation and revisions need checking.

title: SOP for Planned Relocation in Fiji
locator: PDF p. 47, section III 3.1–3.2 and phase tables
finding: Defines staged implementation, required actions, process considerations, outputs, responsible agencies and indicative timelines.
limitations: Complex, discretionary inter-agency process; a detailed SOP is not evidence of executable automation.

title: Dienstanweisung Asyl
authority: BAMF; public copy hosted by asyl.net
locator: PDF pp. 105–107, interpreting and hearing instructions
finding: Internal instructions describe hearing arrangements, interpreter handling, exceptions, rescheduling and case-file recording.
limitations: Government-authored document on a civil-society mirror. Newer 2026 releases were found as leads; this edition is historical.

title: SOP for obtaining IEM acknowledgement
authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
finding: Names officer approval chain, clarification deadlines, rejection grounds and Part-A/Part-B processing.
limitations: Eligibility thresholds and current legal status need reconciliation before mapping for execution.

title: Manuale delle procedure negoziali
finding: Assigns contracting responsibility, procurement-system registration and supplier-list maintenance to named functions.
limitations: Historical manual predates major procurement-law changes; evidence of publication, not a current executable specification.

title: Standard Operation Procedures of the One-Stop Service
authority: Myanmar Investment Commission / participating national departments
finding: Applicant documents lead to technical inspection, director review, fee advice and licence issuance by the director general.
limitations: Nationally issued compilation; present legal and operational applicability unvalidated.

service: Electricity usage permit for a transformer
title: Standard Operation Procedures of the One-Stop Service
authority: Ministry of Electricity and Energy / participating electricity offices
finding: Lists applicant evidence and sequential document, network-capacity and district technical reviews.
limitations: Nationally issued procedure with local delivery offices; no regional or municipal government is counted.

title: SOP for Compliance Departments
locator: Chapter 2.1, PDF p. 9; objection chapter listed
finding: Describes case selection, evidence requests, examination and assessment/objection processes.
limitations: Explicitly informative and without legal force; historical edition must be checked against current practice.

service: Medical supplies request, authorisation and return
title: Manual para manejo y control interno de insumos médicos
locator: PDF pp. 25–28, brigades and CEYE procedures
finding: Names requesters, pharmacy and supplies approvers, forms, consumption checks and return/recording of unused supplies.
limitations: Health logistics rather than patient admission or benefit adjudication.

title: Rundskriv 2020-08: adoption case handling
finding: Assigns assessment, appeal, permission issuance and transfer after a final decision to named authorities.
limitations: Includes regional offices of national bodies and municipal participants; it does not establish municipal publication coverage.

title: Immigration New Zealand: managing skilled residence visa decisions
finding: Audit describes application allocation, assessment and decision stages; operational manual is also publicly indexed.
limitations: Audit is evidence about a specific period, not a guarantee that current delivery is identical.

title: Plan your procurement
document_date: live page; publication date not resolved
locator: Requirements, procurement plan and market approach sections
finding: Gives operational planning tasks, decision choices, supporting documents and approvals within the procurement lifecycle.
limitations: Cross-government recommended process; individual agencies may differ.

title: DESPA-PG.01 Importación para el Consumo, v8
locator: Procedure sections on document requests and continuation of clearance
finding: Names customs officers, reassignment, system records, notifications and inspection/clearance conditions.
limitations: Versioned procedure; inspect change log and amendments for a point-in-time map.

service: Direct procurement by a national ministry medical facility
title: PO-CMDTA-18: direct procurement
authority: Interior Ministry Medical Directorate / CMDTA Ploiești
document_date: hosted February 2024; signed edition date requires checking
finding: Describes necessity documents, beneficiary structures, procurement staff and threshold-triggered changes of procedure.
limitations: A local facility of a national ministry, not a municipality. Cannot be generalised to all national agencies.

title: RPPA Administrative Procedures Manual
finding: Step/responsibility/timeline table specifies Umucyo changes, approval or rejection, reasons and re-registration.
limitations: Other sections and the separate civil-registration SOP require their own checks.

service: Civil service attendance monitoring and personnel administration
title: Government of Samoa HRM Policies & Procedures
authority: Office of the Public Service Commission
locator: PDF pp. 15–17, attendance roles and actions
finding: Managers review attendance, HR submits records and the CEO takes specified follow-up action.
limitations: Historical public-service personnel manual; current determinations may supersede parts.

service: National health service internal requisition and supply
title: Manual de procedimentos para o Serviço Nacional de Saúde
finding: Requester, administrative assistant and approval steps lead to signed delivery records, goods release and consumption filing.
limitations: Back-office workflow; this does not establish end-to-end clinical service coverage.

service: Social welfare desk referrals and case closure at transport hubs
title: National SOP for Social Welfare Service Desk in Transport Hubs
authority: Ministry of Community Development, Gender, Women and Special Groups
finding: Names social-welfare officers, intake/referral functions, referral forms, follow-up and closure.
limitations: National standard with distributed delivery; observed case-handling quality remains untested.

title: Skilled Worker caseworker guidance, v20
locator: Validity, suitability, evidence and decision sections
finding: Explicit staff guidance distinguishes rejection/refusal conditions, caseworker checks and decision requirements.
limitations: Rule interpretation and complete operational routing must still be mapped and reconciled.

title: Field Operations Manual, chapter 3
document_date: live manual; chapter date not resolved
finding: Assigns inspection preparation, employer/employee contact, alternative conference arrangements and inspection sequencing to compliance officers.
limitations: Federal OSHA scope; state-plan authorities are not counted.

title: Manual de habilitación/renovación de empresas
authority: Ministry of Public Health, Technology Evaluation Department
locator: Section 4, PDF p. 4; licensing process sections
finding: Assigns licensing, specialist advice and inspections to named departments and links inspection reports to licensing outcomes.
limitations: Historical version; document identifier contains a placeholder. Current approval and applicability require checking.

service: Public procurement bid opening and evaluation
title: Zimbabwe Public Procurement Guidelines
finding: Defines bid-opening tasks, secure handling, committee handoff and staged evaluation with failure exits.
limitations: Some internal footer dates are placeholders; verify the applicable issued version before reuse.

service: Health ministry document registration and case-file creation
title: Manual de procedimentos internos de serviços de protocolo
locator: Document receipt and registration sections, PDF pp. 9–12
finding: Staff check incoming documents, identify urgency, apply deadlines and create/number case files.
limitations: Back-office records workflow; historical edition does not establish current digital-system behaviour.

title: Saint Lucia Public Procurement Manual
authority: Procurement Administration Unit, Department of Finance
finding: Defines evaluation responsibilities, retained reports, clarification constraints and escalation when bids are rejected.
limitations: The evaluation-plan form reference includes a placeholder; agency-level variants remain untested.

service: Labour economics analysis and indicator production
title: Macroeconomic Labour Policy Group work manual
document_date: hosted May 2026; edition date not resolved
finding: Tables connect input providers, resources, work steps, outputs, recipients and time/quality standards.
limitations: Policy-support workflow, not a citizen-facing service; Thai-language interpretation merits native-speaker review.

title: Unified Planning Procedures Manual
locator: Agricultural engineering requirements and PDF p. 54
finding: Technical reviews, required evidence and infrastructure conditions are public; the inspected table is an engineering calculation sequence.
limitations: Does not yet establish a complete internal case-handling workflow. Separate Tender Board staff guide returned 403.

service: Administrative service centre and complaint handling
title: Internal rules for administrative servicing
authority: Ministry of Labour and Social Policy
finding: Defines front-office arrangements, receiving requests, staff responsibilities and feedback handling.
limitations: Cross-cutting service-centre rules; a specific substantive service still needs a procedure.

title: Manuel de procédures du PAGF
finding: Detailed procedure tables link procurement actions to project actors and approval stages.
limitations: A donor-financed project's procedures; routine national service applicability is unestablished. Kept outside the strong country count.

title: Internal administrative procedure annex
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Environment / NBCA
finding: Named units receive and transfer applications; the annex sets out internal processing stages.
limitations: Approval number and date are blank on the cover. Operational adoption and final version remain unverified.

title: Cabinet Resolution 122/2024: procurement implementing regulations

limitations: Legal requirements alone do not establish the staff-level implementation or systems workflow.
